title: JSON Schema Generator
description: Infer a draft-07 JSON Schema from sample JSON — nested objects, arrays, formats and required fields.
howto: Click Generate to infer the schema.
Review detected types and string formats.
Copy the schema or download schema.json.

faqs.a: The sample is walked recursively: objects become properties, arrays merge their item types, and strings are checked for date-time, email and UUID formats.
All keys seen in the sample — inferred from a single sample, so review it against your real data.
Item types are merged with anyOf so every observed shape stays valid.
JSON Schema draft-07, the most widely supported draft.
